title: Io mi son giovenetta (Ferrabosco)
desc: Domenico Ferrabosco, Io mi son giovenetta, before 1543. 4 voices (Canto, Alto, Tenor, Basso), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0045); edited by Brian Russell, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
